commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,shutil,json
rows=subprocess.run(['adb','devices','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25).stdout.splitlines()[1:]
usb=[r.split()[0] for r in rows if len(r.split())>=2 and r.split()[1]=='device' and ':' not in r.split()[0]]
assert len(usb)==1,len(usb)
serial=usb[0]
for label,cmd in [('RUN_AS',['shell','run-as','com.termux','id']),('DOWNLOAD',['shell','sh','-c','stat -c "%A %u %g" /sdcard/Download; command -v sha256sum || true']),('STORAGE_APP',['shell','sh','-c','pm list packages com.termux; dumpsys package com.termux | grep -m 3 -E "MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE|READ_MEDIA_IMAGES|READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" || true'])]:
 p=subprocess.run(['adb','-s',serial,*cmd],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
 print(json.dumps({'label':label,'exit':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout[-2500:],'stderr':p.stderr[-500:]},ensure_ascii=False))
